title: A folded plot lane counts closed grandchildren it cannot show
detail: The folded Board lane counts closed grandchildren it cannot display. At ac8c5c19d, open a plot with one open direct subplot containing one harvested seed and no direct closed seed. The parent offers a closed item, but Show produces an empty lane. The fallback uses recursive progress, while the board lane and daemon page use direct children. Independently source-confirmed. Use an authoritative direct foldable count for both the count and Show, including off-window direct children. Native probe source is on s-g82g06; run in progress.
